existing_data.scene: f32 RGB linear HDR, after water/cloud effects and sorted rain, before TSR/exposure
existing_data.reuse: Existing 61-frame HDR/presented are context and output references, not a separable rain layer. Late physical states cannot be reproduced by frame-origin alone.

actual_current_resource_map.domain: Logical IDs and pass indices from logical_pass_manifest.json; physical IDs and indices from pass_manifest.json. IDs can change after adding retained stages.

pre_rain.semantics: Actual water/cloud-composited background, including rain-weather lighting; excludes particle compositing. Do not substitute effects_opaque_scene, which precedes water and camera-air/cloud compositing.

composition.ordered_step: C <- C + (P - C) * alpha; coverage <- coverage + (1-coverage)*alpha
composition.identity: Cpost = tau*Cpre + A, tau=1-current_coverage. A is the effective sorted premultiplied rain contribution including each particle's air prefix.
composition.offline: A=Cpost-tau*Cpre; Cnew=A+tau*OIDN(Cpre). Prefer Cnew=Cpost+tau*(OIDN(Cpre)-Cpre) to preserve exact identity when the denoiser makes no change.
composition.numerics: Use f64 CPU arithmetic; retain signed residual roundoff and report it. Do not clamp A or use scene-pre as an additive rain layer. Floating-point ordered blends and coverage recurrence are algebraically affine, not guaranteed bit-identical to recomposition.
composition.coverage_not_reactive: candidate_coverage is current rain only. Do not use out_reactive, which includes previous-coverage rejection and other reactive sources.

minimal_host_only_capture.effects_lane: Add trace tuple (effects_pre_rain,color,pixels*12,extent,3) for composite color before append_rain changes out.outputs.color; existing rain_history0/1 traces at lines 663-664 suffice.
minimal_host_only_capture.core_allow_names: Extend CAPTURE_SEQUENCE_STAGES (currently 56) with effects_pre_rain, rain_history0, rain_history1.
minimal_host_only_capture.core_domain: Add effects_pre_rain to scene_linear_hdr classification at core.rs:3667. Coverage remains f32 diagnostic_data.
minimal_host_only_capture.selection: core.rs:2393 and 2506 preserve selected names; 3655-3660 sequence selection bypasses checkpoint interval and raw-profile filtering. Thus this CLI writes the three stages on EVERY rendered frame, appropriate for a 1-2-frame probe, not sparse output during another 61-frame run.
minimal_host_only_capture.if_sparse_long_capture_is_later_required: Put these stages in checkpoint_readback and a narrowly selected raw profile instead of sequence selection. Not required for the proposed 1-2-frame probe.
minimal_host_only_capture.unwired_file: capture_policy.rs explicitly says Unwired draft and is not the active selector. No change needed there.

parity.rule: Rain uses CloudHistoryState.begin(reset).history_write, not TSR parity. Reset sets read=0, write=1; only successful commit promotes write to read.
parity.continuous_success_no_midrun_reset: f0 current=rain_history1; f1 current=rain_history0; alternates thereafter.
parity.capture_both: host_memory.rs:10-13 filters only TSR/identity/surface-history parity, so both rain histories are read back. Keep both and choose from actual reset/commit progression or binding 19.

lifetime_protection.rule: Selected stage_defs become final_readback_ids before scratch planning. final_readback buffers are excluded from alias reuse; applying the plan validates the same protected set. Therefore selected pre-rain trace is preserved until readback without a new snapshot kernel.
lifetime_protection.limit: Current physical259 cannot be read at frame end as pre-rain: bloom already overwrites it. New capture must select the trace before lifetime planning; use its newly emitted manifest rather than hardcoding old physical IDs.
